name: Lake vs Jim
description: These two founding members feature the only Rivalry in the league where both teams have won a championship. Lake has won 2, including 2025's championship in which he defeated Jim.

name: Gage vs Ryker
description: These two were always bound to be rivals. Chipiness in the league group chat, constant trash talk, and consistent matchups makes this a premier rivalry in the league.

name: Trevor vs Wes
description: Two new dads. Both founding members of the league, yet neither have managed to win a championship yet. This is the leagues most common matchup, having faced off 22 times so far.

name: Nick vs Kip
description: From the mean streets of Olathe Northwest, this rivalry is a long time in the making. With no love lost, every matchup between these two is intense.

name: Farmageddon
description: Just two down to earth country boys. Chisam and Good Ol Boy JR were meant to be rivals. Whether on the fantasy football field, or debating who has shot more turkeys, this is a matchup for the ages.

name: Hayden vs Bush
description: Both joining the league in 2023, this was always bound to be a rivalry.
